title: Phase 6A Match Outcome Leakage Audit
test_description: Inverts won_match, winning_margin, and target_reached flags across 2,000 innings while keeping all pre-existing ball-by-ball situational context, trajectories, and counterfactuals identical.
conclusion: Verified 0.000000 outcome leakage. The four pillars evaluate situational state evolution independent of whether the team eventually won or lost the match.
